name: Socrates
description: An AI tutor for people who want to understand. Socrates pairs a Socratic dialogue tutor with a recall queue and a knowledge map so that what you learn is what you can use again.

schemes.name: sid
schemes.description: Browser session cookie issued by /api/auth/login. HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, 64-hex.

schemes.name: mobileBearer
schemes.description: Authorization: Bearer ma.<pairId>.<64-hex>. 15-minute TTL. Pair with /api/mobile/refresh using the matching mr.* refresh token.

schemes.name: X-CSRF-Token
schemes.description: Required for state-changing browser routes. Issued by GET /api/auth/csrf-token.

schemes.name: github
schemes.description: Third-party GitHub OAuth flow that issues a sid cookie on exchange.

skills.name: Socratic dialogue
skills.description: Ask-then-answer tutoring style. The tutor asks before it answers.

skills.name: Recall queue
skills.description: Schedule prompts that surface saved moments at the right interval.

skills.name: Knowledge map
skills.description: Maintain a map of relationships between ideas across a user's sessions.

skills.name: Exam mode
skills.description: Retrieval-practice mode that surfaces questions at the end of a study block.

skills.name: Mistake book
skills.description: Collects moments where the learner's explanation showed a seam.

skills.name: Markdown twin publishing
skills.description: Every research note is published as a markdown twin alongside its HTML.
